title: headcount-sync-hiring-planning-scratchpad
content:
Notes to self / scratchpad for upcoming headcount sync (weekly) and follow-ups. Informal - work through agenda + action items.

Context:
- Weekly headcount sync with Eng managers + Finance cadence. Focus this week: finalize Q2 hiring plan for Serving Runtime and SRE; confirm dedicated hires and timeline for Private infra team.
- Hiring freeze lift discussion pending exec approval for 6 net new engineers (2 serving-runtime, 2 infra, 2 SRE) + 1 recruiting coordinator.

Agenda draft (30m):
1) Quick numbers (5m): current open reqs, offers outstanding, acceptance pipeline
   - Open reqs: 18 active (list below)
   - Offers out: 4 (2 for Serving Runtime, 1 infra, 1 SRE)
   - Hiring velocity: avg 45 days from req to offer last quarter
2) Prioritization (10m): which reqs to accelerate if approval comes through
   - Priority A: 2 Serving Runtime (latency infra), 1 SRE (oncall scale)
   - Priority B: 2 Infra (dedicated infra for Private), 1 Eng tools
3) Interview loop health (5m): loop completeness, interviewer load, diversity signals
   - Gaps: missing infra tech lead interviewer from 1 candidate loop (Marcus out)
   - Action: swap Priya in for backend systems questions
4) Approvals & budget (5m): confirm POs/budget signoff timeline from Finance (Samir following up)
5) Action items & next steps (5m)

Quick list of open reqs (short):
- SR-ENG-01: Serving Runtime - Performance (req owner: Marcus)
- SR-ENG-02: Serving Runtime - Quant/Kernels (owner: TBD)
- SRE-03: Reliability - Oncall scale (owner: Priya)
- INF-04: Private Deployments - Platform infra (owner: Samir)
- REC-05: Recruiting Coordinator (owner: HR)
- +13 others (see confluence/HR-headcount-2026)

Interview loop notes (recent debriefs):
- Candidate A (Serving Runtime): strong latency debugging, missed quantization depth question, panel liked culture fit. Recommend: move to manager onsite.
- Candidate B (Infra): red flags on infra ownership, but strong on systems design. Consider: assign second loop focusing on ownership examples.
- Candidate C (SRE): excellent signal, flagged for rapid offer.

Debrief action items (from last week's loops):
- Marcus: follow up with Candidate B to schedule ownership-focused loop (due 2026-02-24) - PENDING
- Priya: share calibrated rubric doc for SRE interviews in #recruiting (done 2026-02-18) - DONE
- Samir: confirm budget timing with Finance (jira JIRA-HR-3421) - IN PROGRESS (meeting 2026-02-21)
- Avery (me): update headcount tracker and push prioritized reqs to exec deck (due 2026-02-22) - DONE

Open questions / risks:
- If exec approval delayed beyond 3/15/2026, hiring velocity will push Q2 starts to Q3 for 60% of prioritized reqs. Need contingency: push offers for critical roles earlier?
- Interviewer fatigue: Serving Runtime panel scheduled heavy this week (9 onsite loops). Consider temporary external interviewers or lighten onsite schedule.
- Compensation band compression on infra senior ICs - may need to move budget or consider leveling adjustments.

Follow-ups to prepare before sync:
- Short deck slide: 1) current open numbers, 2) top 6 prioritized reqs with justification, 3) budget ask (amount + rationale), 4) hiring timeline scenarios (approve now vs approve in 6 weeks).
- Pull headcount tracker export (sheet) and attach: CON-HEADCOUNT-EXPORT-2026-02-18 (linked in confluence)
- Ping Finance for explicit approval window and any constraints (Samir owning)

Draft talking points for execs (concise):
- "We have 6 high-priority hires that materially reduce inference latency and oncall burn; approving now will enable hires to start in early Q2 and preserve candidate pipeline. Delaying risks losing top candidates and pushes critical infra work into Q3."
- "We are committed to diversity and interview calibration; additional headcount will be accompanied by structured rubrics and interviewer training sessions."

Todo checklist (short):
- [ ] Finalize slide + numbers (Avery) - target 2026-02-22
- [ ] Confirm budget window (Samir) - target 2026-02-21
- [ ] Reassign interviewer for infra loop (Marcus) - target 2026-02-24
- [ ] Shortlist candidate offer priorities (Priya) - target 2026-02-23
- [ ] Update confluence page with approved plan (post-approval) (Owner: Avery)

Quick links referenced:
- confluence/HR-headcount-2026 (master tracker)
- JIRA-HR-3421 (budget approval ticket)
- slack-thread-CNTR-ops-hires (internal discussion)

Notes to self: keep this doc messy. Capture any manager asks during sync and convert into JIRA tasks after meeting. If exec asks for alternatives, have "pause hires" vs "prioritize critical 3" scenario prepared.

Recent changes log (small):
- 2026-02-18: Added SRE Candidate C recommendation (Priya)
- 2026-02-20: Updated offers out count after Candidate D declined
